channels.name: CK_t / CK_c
channels.purpose: Forwarded differential clock; commands captured on the rising edge.

channels.name: DQ[63:0] (module) / [3:0],[7:0],[15:0] (device)
channels.purpose: Data bus; double data rate on DQS edges.

channels.name: DQS_t / DQS_c
channels.purpose: Data strobe; one pair per byte (two pairs on x16).

channels.name: DM_n / DBI_n
channels.purpose: Data mask / Data Bus Inversion (shared pin per byte).

channels.name: ACT_n + RAS_n/A16 + CAS_n/A15 + WE_n/A14 + A[13:0] + BG + BA
channels.purpose: Command / address bus behind the ACT_n flag.

channels.name: PAR / ALERT_n
channels.purpose: Command-address parity in; CA-parity / write-CRC / connectivity alert out.

channels.name: CKE / CS_n / ODT / RESET_n / ZQ
channels.purpose: Clock enable / chip select / ODT control / reset / calibration reference.

handshake_pairs.name: ACTIVATE/READ
handshake_pairs.rule: ACTIVATE opens the row; READ after tRCD.

handshake_pairs.name: WRITE/CRC
handshake_pairs.rule: WRITE drives data CWL later; a write-CRC frame follows when enabled (ALERT_n on error).

handshake_pairs.name: CA parity
handshake_pairs.rule: PAR covers command/address; ALERT_n on a parity error.

handshake_pairs.name: ODT
handshake_pairs.rule: ODT pin selects Rtt_Nom; Rtt_PARK applies when deasserted.

dependency_graph.common_rule: The JESD79-4 power-up/init (DLL reset, ZQ calibration, MRS of MR0..MR6, VrefDQ training) must complete before normal commands. A bank must be ACTIVE (tRCD met) before a column READ/WRITE; PRECHARGE (tRP) closes the row.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A READ/WRITE requires (1) the device initialized and trained, (2) the target row ACTIVE, (3) bank-group timing (tCCD_S/L) satisfied; write CRC / CA parity protect data and command.

power_pins.name: VPP
power_pins.purpose: 2.5 V wordline / activating pump supply (new in DDR4).

channel_counts_quad_die_x8.note: Stacked / quad-die packages multiply CKE / CS / ODT / ZQ per die (CKE0/CKE1, CS0#..CS3#, ODT0/ODT1, ZQ0..ZQ3).

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: POD12 single-ended CA/DQ; differential CK/DQS; double data rate on DQS edges; BL8/BC4 burst order.
ordering_rules.command_order: ACTIVATE -> READ/WRITE -> PRECHARGE per bank, subject to tRCD/tRP/tRAS and bank-group timing.
ordering_rules.bank_group: Different-bank-group accesses run at tCCD_S; same-group at tCCD_L.

logical_signaling_levels.name: POD12
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Pseudo Open Drain at 1.2 V; terminated to VDDQ via on-die termination.
